what_works: Light green textured background creates a calm, focused canvas while maintaining visual interest.
Vibrant orange-red accent color highlights primary actions and provides strong contrast for navigation.
Consistent 40% rounded corners soften UI elements, aligning with flat design aesthetics.
Clear typographic hierarchy using distinct fonts for headings and monospace for code snippets improves readability.
Well-defined interactive components such as tabs, cards, and prominent call‑to‑action buttons guide user flow.
